meta.name: prisma-cli
meta.description: Prisma ORM 7 CLI reference for existing Prisma 7 applications or explicitly selected Prisma 7 workflows. Covers prisma init, generate, migrate, db, dev, studio, and mcp. For setup, connection repair, or Prisma 8, use prisma-orm-setup; not the Prisma Platform CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行管理数据库:生成客户端、跑迁移、查看数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在用 Prisma 7,想用命令行跑迁移、生成客户端和查看数据
copy.tagline_en: Generate clients, run migrations, and browse data from the terminal
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Prisma 7 and prefer the command line for migrations and client generation

howto.what: Claude 会按 Prisma ORM 7 CLI 的写法帮你执行 init、generate、migrate、db 等命令,并给出 prisma.config.ts 配置与各命令的参考文档。
howto.when: 当你在已有的 Prisma 7 项目里需要初始化、生成客户端或跑迁移等 CLI 操作时触发。项目搭建、连接修复或 Prisma 8 请改用 prisma-orm-setup。

say.text: 帮我给这个 Prisma 7 项目跑 prisma generate 生成客户端
say.note: 使用项目版本匹配的 CLI,不装 prisma@latest

howto.what_en: Claude follows the Prisma ORM 7 CLI syntax to run commands like init, generate, migrate and db, and shares prisma.config.ts setup plus per-command reference docs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you work in an existing Prisma 7 project and need CLI tasks such as init, generate or migrate. For setup, connection repair or Prisma 8, use prisma-orm-setup instead.

say_en.text: Run prisma generate for this Prisma 7 project to build the client
say_en.note: Uses the version-matched CLI, not prisma@latest

say_en.text: Create a migration with prisma migrate dev --name add_users_table
say_en.note: Creates and applies the migration; run generate after

say_en.text: Help me set schema and datasource paths in prisma.config.ts
